title: Sign assignments outside a subset
statement: For a natural number $n$ and a subset $J\subseteq\mathrm{Fin}(n)$, the fixed sign cube consists of all assignments of a sign in $\{−1,1\}$ to each index in $\mathrm{Fin}(n)\setminus J$.
